8.22. iLock_Geography.pispec_configurator¶

pispec_configurator.py

This module contains the PiSPECConfigurator class and the rule classes (rule, geoInstRule, piInstRule and piPredRule).

8.22.1. To-do¶

  • Store rules in the UtilityAPI storage.
  • Retreive the rules in the T-phase and produce documentation.
  • Have some tag, in the PiSPECCOnfigurator and in the individual rules, which can keep track of which package is using the PiSPECConfigurator at the moment. The tag should be documented in the rules.
  • Extend piInstRule-doc with functionality to retreive configuration-information from outside files, e.g. graphics.tm.
  • The origin-information (inspect.currentframe()) could be wiewed nicer.
  • Investigate why line number of the frame record is always 1; solve it!
